    Small fires for the ignitions that did not escape

    smallFires.Rd

    Each ignition gets a size drawn from sizesHa (the observed fires below escapeSizeHa), turned into pixels with the expected area kept (a 2.5-pixel fire is 2 pixels half the time, 3 the other half), and burns that many burnable pixels around it. Pixels already burned this year, and pixels with no spread probability, do not burn. Fires of 0 pixels, and ignitions on such pixels, burn nothing.

    smallFires(loci, sizesHa, landscape, spreadProb, burned = integer())

    Arguments

    loci

    Ignition pixels (cell numbers of landscape).

    sizesHa

    Numeric vector of fire sizes (ha) to draw from; NULL or empty: nothing burns.

    landscape

    SpatRaster giving the grid and pixel size.

    spreadProb

    Numeric vector, one per pixel: NA or 0 is not burnable.

    burned

    Pixels already burned this year.

    Value

    A data.table with initialPixels and pixels, one row per burned pixel.
